text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as it always was is fine. 
Please... move. Move, damn it...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the waiting room, Tamamo Cross rubbed 
her legs with hands clasped together as if 
in prayer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, yeah! No problem at all. See, my 
legs are totally stretched and ready to 
go!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No matter the situation, I'll blow right 
past 'em. I won't put on an embarrassing 
race. 'Cause I'm... 'cause I'm...!
